'''Frederik van der Blij''' (13{{nbsp}}May 1923{{snd}}27{{nbsp}}January 2018)<ref>[https://www.uu.nl/en/news/professor-emeritus-frederik-van-der-blij-passed-away Professor Emeritus Frederik van der Blij passed away]</ref> was a Dutch [[mathematician]]. From 1955 until his retirement in 1988 he was professor at the [[University of Utrecht]]. His research focused on [[number theory]], among other fields.<ref>{{cite journal |title=Gezien de verschillen : Interview met F. van der Blij |first=A. G. |last=van Asch |year=2000 |journal=Euclides |volume=75 |issue=8 |pages=264–266}}</ref>
